recognize_zh: 骨小樑（左側粉紅色骨質）旁的造血組織中，貼著骨小樑的區域有一群核圓至卵圓、細胞質呈粉紅顆粒狀的未成熟骨髓系細胞（myelocytes），下方可見細胞質鮮紅顆粒的嗜酸性球，右側則有核小而深染的紅血球前驅細胞。
features: Bone trabecula on the left with a paratrabecular band of hematopoietic cells and adjacent fat spaces
Paratrabecular immature myeloid cells with round to oval or slightly indented vesicular nuclei and moderate granular eosinophilic cytoplasm
Two cells near the bottom with bright red coarse cytoplasmic granules, consistent with eosinophils/eosinophilic precursors
Right side shows clusters of cells with small, round, dense hyperchromatic nuclei, consistent with erythroid precursors
Elongated spindle nuclei lining the trabecular surface (osteoblasts/stromal cells); no atypical infiltrate
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with adjacent trilineage hematopoietic marrow and fat. The paratrabecular zone contains a band of immature myeloid cells, including myelocytes with round to oval vesicular nuclei and moderate granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, in keeping with the normal paratrabecular localization of early granulopoiesis. Two eosinophilic forms with bright red granules are present near the bottom, and erythroid precursors with small round dense nuclei are clustered toward the right. No abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or atypical localization of immature precursors is identified. Findings are consistent with normal paratrabecular myeloid maturation.

ddx.vs: ALIP refers to clusters of blasts/promyelocytes located centrally away from trabeculae, whereas these maturing myeloid cells are appropriately paratrabecular.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei with a perinuclear hof and amphophilic cytoplasm rather than granular eosinophilic cytoplasm; CD138 confirms.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular aggregates of spindled mast cells with clear to pale cytoplasm, often with fibrosis and admixed eosinophils, confirmed by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
